key_decisions.original_text: SFI for Hegota: EIP-8015 (beacon state cleanup)
EIP-8365: whether to burn ETH from post-fork 0x00 deposits or re-queue the balance as a 0x01 deposit (Barnabas' proposal) deferred two weeks; to be discussed at Devcon and resolved next call
key_decisions.context: Choice is between burning the ETH (simpler) and Barnabas' proposal to re-queue the balance so nothing is burned
